item.title: Microsoft researchers demonstrate hidden backdoor technique for AI agents
item.description: Microsoft researchers have demonstrated how small changes to an AI model can implant a hidden backdoor, causing an agent to execute an attacker’s command when a specific trigger appears. The technique, called Lazarus, requires no model retraining and allows the agent to behave normally during standard safety evaluations. item.title: Embed Security lets analysts teach its AI SOC Platform how to investigate
item.description: Embed Security announced new capabilities that let security teams teach Embed how they investigate, what matters in their environment, and how to improve their detections. With customer-built iSteps, expanded NoiseIQ Memories, and Detection Engineering, organizations can extend Embed’s built-in security expertise with their own knowledge and operating practices.
